message.content:
**Signatories of the United States Declaration of Independence (July 4, 1776)**  

| State | Signers (in order of appearance on the original parchment) |
|-------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, George Calvert |
| **Pennsylvania** | Robert Morris, Benjamin Rush, Benjamin Franklin, John Morton, George Clymer, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Ross, James Smith (duplicate), John Penn |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Witherspoon, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Abraham Clark, William Livingston, John Hart (duplicate), John Witherspoon (duplicate) |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, John Adams, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock (duplicate), John Adams (duplicate) |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll (duplicate) |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, James McClenahan |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison, Thomas Jefferson (duplicate) |
| **New York** | Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris, William Floyd, Philip Livingston (duplicate) |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Stephen Hopkins (duplicate) |

> **Total:** 56 individuals (some names appear twice because they signed on different pages or were listed twice in the original document).

These men represented the thirteen colonies and formally adopted the Declaration on July 4, 1776, declaring independence from Great Britain.
